title: Kernel benchmark service
responsibility: Measures cold and warm latency, throughput, and available memory for the configured module, Wasm, process, and HTTP kernel runtimes.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.constructor.plan
inputs.description: CLI vector, fresh-process sample count and warm-loop iteration count.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.constructor.context
inputs.description: Revision/profile context attached to each benchmark measurement.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.measure.run
inputs.description: Validated workload run containing request, node count, seed and ID.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.measure.url
inputs.description: URL of the already running HTTP kernel server; used for the HTTP runtime.

inputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.describe.run
inputs.description: Workload request whose size facts are reported.

inputs.name: serveKernel.cli
inputs.description: CLI executable and leading arguments used to launch the kernel server.

inputs.name: serveKernel.startupTimeoutMs
inputs.description: Maximum wait for valid server readiness output.

outputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.measure
outputs.description: Cold and warm latency, throughput and memory measurement entries for each configured runtime; memory may be reported unavailable when it cannot be attributed.

outputs.name: KernelBenchmarkService.describe
outputs.description: Workload dimensions and serialized request/response byte counts derived from the request.

outputs.name: serveKernel
outputs.description: Ready server URL plus a stop function that signals the launched child.

errors.name: ExpectedCliError
errors.description: benchmark measurement requires the kernel build and rejects cold samples that exit unsuccessfully

errors.name: Kernel server startup failure
errors.description: serveKernel rejects on spawn error, timeout, early child exit or invalid readiness JSON
examples: Kernel server returned invalid readiness data.
